text: City Council has authorized the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the North Toronto Memorial Arena Board. This report recommends two candidates for appointment to the board.

North York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidates to the North Toronto Memorial Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on April 20, 2025, and until successors are appointed: Syl Apps Alan Crawford
